update.releaseNotes: MetroMate ka naya update aa gaya hai! Naye features aur bug fixes ke liye abhi update karein.

notifications.title: Welcome to MetroMate! 🚆
notifications.message: App download karne ke liye shukriya. Ab Patna Metro ka route aur fare ek click me check karein.

notifications.title: Blue Line Alert
notifications.message: Blue Line par maintenance ka kaam chal raha hai. Kripya apni yatra ka dhyan rakhein.

notifications.title: Smart Card Discount
notifications.message: Smart Card use karne par har yatra par 10% ki chhoot payein!
